meta.title: For Realtors
meta.description: Your clients deserve a builder you trust. Partner with Larchwood Construction for reliable, transparent custom home building in Montana's Flathead Valley.

hero.heading: Your Clients Deserve a Builder
hero.text: When your client purchases land and needs a builder, we want to be your first recommendation. A partnership that makes you look good and keeps your clients coming back.

problem.heading: You've Seen It
paragraphs: Your client hires the wrong contractor. The project goes sideways. Ghosting. Delays. Excuses. Unprofessional job sites. And the relationship you built with that client suffers.
When a land buyer needs a builder, the referral you make reflects directly on you. A bad recommendation costs you future business.

cards.title: One Project Focus
cards.text: Your client is the only client. One project at a time means undivided attention, clear communication, and no excuses about other jobs.

cards.title: Clear Communication
cards.text: Monthly cost breakdowns, regular progress meetings, and direct phone access. Your client will never wonder what's happening with their build.

cards.title: Professional Job Sites
cards.text: Clean, organized, and safe. A job site you'd be comfortable walking through with a prospective buyer — because that's exactly the kind of operation we run.

cards.title: Reputation-Built Business
cards.text: 30 years of work, zero advertising. Every project has come through earned trust and personal relationships. That track record protects your referral.

items.title: Reliable Referral Partner
items.text: One call to me saves your client months of searching and vetting builders.

items.title: Client Updates
items.text: I'll keep you in the loop on your client's build progress if desired.

items.title: Professional Representation
items.text: My job sites and finished product make you look good. Guaranteed.

items.title: Future Referrals Back
items.text: Buyers of completed homes need realtors. I send business both ways.

cta.heading: Let's
cta.text: I want to be your first call when a client is looking to purchase land and hire a builder. Let's start that relationship.
